messages:
Sam: Quick QBR pulse for Arclight (credits alarm). Need a 30d burn forecast, immediate mitigations, and a short enablement checklist. Elaine, can you run the forecast? Tess, any fast throttles we can propose? Marta, can you own a 45m optimization session? Jordan, standby for promo-credit escalation.

Elaine: Running a 30-day lookback now. I'll return baseline, -10% quick wins, and -25% optimized scenarios with tokens->credits->USD conversion. ETA 25m.

Onboard-Bot: Alert at 6123456789: account=arclight, credit_balance=1420 (~13% left), avg_daily_usage=980, projected_runway~=1.45 weeks.

Tess: Pattern shows many small embedding calls; batching inefficiency. Quick playbook: 1) soft embeddings RPM cap for 48-72h, 2) client-side batcher snippet, 3) prefix cache for repeated contexts. Draft throttle snippet below:
```\nembeddings_throttle:\n  max_rpm: 50\n  duration: 72h\n  rollback_if: errors_rate > 0.5%\n  resume_if: 7d_avg <= baseline * 0.8\n```
Will add alerting rules to notify CS on trigger.

Marta: I'll run the 45m session. Draft agenda: 5m intro, 15m usage anatomy, 20m live batching + cache tweaks, 5m next steps. Deliverable: 1-page ops playbook + PR template. EOD prep.

Elaine: Preliminary projections:
- Continuation: runway ~10 days
- -10% quick wins: ~12 days
- -25% optimized + batching: ~17 days
Conversion: 1k tokens ~= 3 credits; 1 credit ~= $0.0045 USD. I'll attach CSV + chart to the packet.

Sam: Great. Action items: Elaine (CSV/chart) 25m, Tess (throttle playbook) 30m, Marta (session + PR template) EOD, Jordan (escalation) on-call. If forecast <14d escalate. I'll assemble QBR packet when artifacts land. :thumbsup:
